o: He's sawing a piece of wood.
He's hanging a tool on the wall.
p1.x: 줄자로 판자 길이를 재는 동작 → C. A는 톱이 꺼진 채 놓여 있을 뿐 자르는 중 아님. B는 벽 공구판 연상 함정. D는 이미 쓰고 있는 ‘상태’(wearing)를 ‘쓰는 중’(putting on)으로 바꾼 대표 함정.

o: She's pushing a cart down an aisle.
She's lifting a box onto a shelf.
Some boxes are being unloaded from a truck.
p1.x: 상자 실은 카트를 통로로 미는 중 → A. B는 상자를 선반에 올리는 동작 없음. C는 사진에 트럭이 없음(없는 사물). D는 바닥이 깨끗하다는 연상만 이용한 동작 오답.

o: They're arranging chairs around a table.
A woman is pouring coffee into cups.
One of the men is opening a window.
A man is handing a document to a woman.
p1.x: 남자가 여자에게 서류를 건네는 장면 → D. A는 모두 앉아 있어 의자 배치 동작 없음. B는 머그잔만 있고 따르는 동작 없음(사물 연상). C는 창문이 보일 뿐 여는 사람 없음.

o: They're digging a hole in the ground.
A pipe is being installed on a wall.
p1.x: 두 사람이 파이프를 함께 나르는 중 → B. A는 사다리가 기대어 있을 뿐 오르는 사람 없음. C는 굴착기 연상 함정, 땅 파는 동작 없음. D는 pipe를 반복한 수동태 진행 함정 — 벽에 설치 중이 아님.

o: Some chairs are being stacked in a corner.
A screen is being installed on the wall.
A plant has been placed on the table.
Some chairs have been pushed under a table.
p1.x: 의자들이 테이블 밑으로 넣어져 있는 ‘상태’ → D(have been p.p.). 사람이 없는 사진에서 A·B의 is being p.p.(진행 중 동작)는 오답 신호. C는 화분이 테이블 위가 아니라 구석 바닥에 있음(위치 함정).

o: Some boats are docked along a pier.
Some people are fishing from a bridge.
A boat is being tied to a post.
Some passengers are boarding a ferry.
p1.x: 배들이 부두를 따라 정박해 있는 상태 → A. B·D는 사진에 사람이 없음(없는 인물 함정). C는 밧줄로 묶인 ‘상태’를 is being p.p.(묶는 중)로 바꾼 함정 — 묶는 사람이 없음.

p2.q: When is the new software update going to be installed?
o: The IT team hasn't announced that yet.
I updated my address last week.
p2.x: When에 ‘아직 공지 안 됨’으로 우회한 B(간접 응답). A는 장소(Where) 답, C는 update 반복 함정.

p2.q: Where should I put these boxes of brochures?
o: Next to the reception desk is fine.
p2.x: Where에 ‘안내데스크 옆’ 위치로 답한 C. A는 수량(How many) 답, brochures→copies 연상. B는 WH 의문문에 Yes 함정.

p2.q: Did you get a chance to review the budget proposal?
o: I'm going to do that after lunch.
There's a chance of rain tomorrow.
The budget hotel near the airport.
p2.x: Yes/No 없이 ‘점심 후에 할 예정’ = 아직 안 봤다는 A(간접 응답). B는 chance, C는 budget 반복 함정.

p2.q: Why don't we move the client meeting to Thursday?
o: Mr. Okafor is out of the office that day.
p2.x: Why don't we는 이유가 아니라 제안. ‘그날 오카포 씨 부재’로 사실상 거절한 C(간접 응답). A는 Why→Because 함정, B는 요일 연상 + meeting→met 함정.

p2.q: Who's going to lead the training session for new hires?
p2.x: Who에 ‘린드퀴스트 씨가 자원’으로 사람을 답한 B. A는 session 반복 + 시간 답, C는 Yes 함정 + hires→hired 반복.

p2.q: The printer on the third floor is jammed again.
p2.x: 고장 알림에 ‘관리실에 연락하겠다’는 해결책 A. B는 third 반복, C는 jammed→jam 유사발음 함정.

p2.q: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
p2.x: 둘 중 ‘아무거나 남는 자리’로 답한 C(선택 의문문 단골 정답). A는 선택 의문문에 Yes 함정, B는 seat→flight 연상.

p2.q: How did the product launch go yesterday?
p2.x: How did ~ go? = ‘어땠어?’ 결과를 묻는 질문 → ‘기대 이상’ B. A는 How를 수단으로 착각시키는 함정, C는 launch 반복 + 시제 불일치.

p2.q: You've already submitted your expense report, haven't you?
o: I'm still waiting for one receipt.
p2.x: ‘영수증 하나 기다리는 중’ = 아직 못 냈다는 A(간접 응답). B는 report 반복, C는 expense→expensive 유사발음.

p2.q: What time does the shuttle to the convention center leave?
o: The convention was a big success.
There's a timetable posted by the elevators.
p2.x: What time에 ‘엘리베이터 옆 시간표 확인’으로 우회한 C(간접 응답). A는 장소 답, B는 convention 반복.

p2.q: Could you send me the updated floor plan by noon?
o: Sure, I'm just finishing it now.
p2.x: 요청에 ‘물론, 지금 마무리 중’으로 수락한 B. A는 floor 반복, C는 plan→planted 유사발음.

p2.q: Why is the parking lot closed today?
o: I parked on the second level.
p2.x: Why에 ‘재포장 공사 중’이라는 이유 A. B는 closed(닫힌)→close(가까운) 다의어 함정, C는 parking→parked 반복.

p2.q: Is Mr. Haddad joining us for the site visit?
o: His flight was canceled this morning.
p2.x: ‘비행기 결항’ = 못 온다는 C(간접 응답). A는 site→website 반복, B는 Yes + visit 반복 함정(질문과 시점이 다름).

p2.q: Where can I find the minutes from last week's meeting?
o: Ms. Tanaka keeps them in a shared folder.
p2.x: Where에 ‘다나카 씨가 공유 폴더에 보관’으로 담당자+위치를 알려준 A(간접 응답). minutes는 ‘회의록’ — B는 ‘분’ 다의어 함정, C는 When 답.

p2.q: Isn't the quarterly review scheduled for today?
o: It was pushed back to Friday.
We sold more in the third quarter.
p2.x: 부정 의문문 → ‘금요일로 연기됐다’ B. A는 review 반복, C는 quarterly→quarter 연상 함정.

p2.q: When will the renovations to the lobby be finished?
o: The contractor said by the end of the month.
p2.x: When에 ‘월말까지’ 시점으로 답한 C. A는 renovation 연상(로비 가구), B는 lobby 반복 + 경로 답.

p2.q: Let's order lunch for the whole team today.
o: Good idea. I'll get the menus.
p2.x: 제안에 ‘좋아요, 메뉴판 가져올게’로 수락한 A. B는 order(주문)→order(순서) 다의어, C는 team 반복.

p2.q: How many people have signed up for the workshop?
p2.x: How many에 ‘등록은 금요일 마감’ = 아직 최종 인원 미정이라는 B(간접 응답). A는 sign 반복, C는 장소 답.

p2.q: I can't log in to the company's online portal.
o: You may need to reset your password.
p2.x: 로그인 문제에 ‘비밀번호 재설정’ 해결책 C. A는 Yes + company 반복, B는 log(기록하다) 반복 함정.

p2.q: Who approved the change to the delivery schedule?
o: It was decided at the managers' meeting.
We changed trains at Central Station.
p2.x: Who에 특정인 대신 ‘관리자 회의에서 결정’으로 답한 A(간접 응답). B는 When 답, C는 change→changed 반복.

p2.q: Have you met the new marketing director yet?
o: She's coming by our office this afternoon.
Yes, we met our sales targets.
p2.x: ‘오늘 오후 사무실에 들른대요’ = 아직 못 만났다는 B(간접 응답). A는 marketing→market 유사발음, C는 Yes + met(달성하다) 다의어 함정.

p2.q: Should we print the handouts now, or wait until the final draft is ready?
o: Let's wait. There may be more changes.
p2.x: 후자(기다리기)를 고르고 이유까지 댄 C. A는 선택 의문문에 Yes + handouts→hand out 함정, B는 draft(초안)→draft beer 다의어.

p2.q: Would you mind covering my shift on Saturday?
o: Sorry, I'm visiting my parents that weekend.
p2.x: 부탁에 ‘미안, 그 주말 부모님 댁’으로 거절한 A. B는 cover 반복, C는 shift→shifted 반복.

p2.q: What did the clients think of our proposal?
o: They want to discuss the pricing first.
p2.x: 고객 반응을 ‘가격부터 논의하고 싶어 한다’로 전한 B(간접 응답). A는 think 반복, C는 proposal→proposed 반복.

p2.q: The keynote speaker's flight has been delayed.
o: Then we'll switch the order of the presentations.
p2.x: 연사 지연 소식에 ‘발표 순서 바꾸자’는 대응 C. A는 장소 답, B는 Yes + speaker→spoke 연상 함정.

p3.script:
W Hi, Dennis. The printer on the third floor keeps jamming, and I have to print forty copies of the quarterly report for this afternoon's board meeting.
M Oh no. Facilities said the technician can't come until Thursday. Have you tried the one in the marketing department?
W I did, but it's out of toner. And the copy shop down the street closes early on Wednesdays.
M Well, I'm heading to our Harbor Street branch for a client lunch in half an hour. Their printers are much newer.
W Really? Could you print the copies there and bring them back with you?
M Sure. Just e-mail me the file, and let me know if you need them stapled.
W Thanks! I'll send it right now. Single-sided, and yes, stapled, please.

qs.q: What problem does the woman mention?
o: A printer is not working properly.
A board meeting has been postponed.
A client has canceled an order.
qs.x: 첫 대사 ‘프린터가 계속 걸린다(keeps jamming)’가 정답 근거. 파트3 첫 문제 답은 거의 항상 첫 두 줄에 있습니다.

qs.q: Where will the man go soon?
qs.x: 남자 ‘Harbor Street branch(다른 지점)에 30분 후 간다’가 근거. copy shop은 수요일 일찍 닫는다고 했으니 함정입니다.

qs.q: What will the woman most likely do next?
qs.x: 남자 ‘파일을 이메일로 보내 달라’ → 여자 ‘I'll send it right now’. 마지막 대사가 다음 행동 근거입니다.

p3.script:
M Good morning, Lakeview Hotel front desk. How can I help you?
W Hi, this is Priya Nair. I have a reservation for three nights starting October twentieth, but my conference schedule changed. I'll need to arrive a day earlier.
M Let me check... Yes, we have a room available on the nineteenth. However, it's a standard room rather than the ocean-view suite you booked.
W That's fine for one night. Can I move into the suite on the twentieth?
M Absolutely. I'll note that on your reservation. Also, since you're attending the conference, you can use our free shuttle to the convention center. It leaves every hour from the main entrance.
W Oh, that's great. Do I need to sign up for it?
M Yes. Just stop by the concierge desk when you check in, and they'll give you a shuttle pass.

qs.q: Why is the woman calling?
qs.x: ‘하루 일찍 도착해야 한다(arrive a day earlier)’가 전화 목적. 날짜 변경 요청입니다.

qs.q: What does the man say about the room available on the nineteenth?
o: It is a different type of room.
It costs more than her original room.
qs.x: ‘스위트가 아니라 standard room’이라고 함 → 방 종류가 다르다. ocean-view는 원래 예약한 방이라 함정입니다.

qs.q: What does the man tell the woman to do when she checks in?
qs.x: 마지막 대사 ‘체크인할 때 concierge desk에 들르면 셔틀 패스를 준다’가 근거입니다.

p3.script:
W1 Mark, Elena, thanks for joining. We've received twelve applications for the graphic designer position, and we need to narrow them down by Friday.
M I've already gone through about half. Honestly, only three of them have experience with packaging design, which is what this role mostly involves.
W2 I noticed that too. But one applicant, Ji-ho Park, has no packaging experience, and her portfolio is remarkable. I think we should talk to her anyway.
W1 All right, let's include her. Elena, could you set up video interviews for next week?
W2 Sure. Should I book them in the mornings? Mark, you're at the trade show on Tuesday afternoon, right?
M That's right. Mornings would work best for me.
W1 Great. And I'll ask Human Resources to prepare a short design test for the candidates to complete beforehand.

qs.q: What job opening are the speakers discussing?
qs.x: 첫 대사 ‘graphic designer position 지원서 12장’이 근거. 3인 대화도 주제는 첫 줄에 나옵니다.

qs.q: Why does one of the women recommend interviewing Ji-ho Park?
o: She was referred by a coworker.
qs.x: Elena ‘포장 경력은 없지만 portfolio가 remarkable’ → impressive로 바꿔 말한 것. 포장 경력은 오히려 없다고 했으니 함정입니다.

qs.q: What will Human Resources be asked to do?
qs.x: 마지막 대사 ‘HR에 짧은 design test를 준비해 달라고 하겠다’ → skills test로 패러프레이즈.

p3.script:
M Hi, I'm calling from Ortega Engineering. We're holding a training session next Monday for about thirty employees, and I'd like to order lunch.
W Certainly. Have you had a chance to look at our lunch packages online?
M Yes. My manager wants something warm since it's getting cold, but our budget is limited to twenty-five dollars per person.
W In that case, I'd recommend this package. It includes two hot dishes, rice, and a dessert.
M That sounds perfect. Some of our staff are vegetarian, though.
W No problem. We can make one of the hot dishes vegetarian at no extra charge. Could you give me the exact number of people by Thursday?
M Will do. I'll confirm the number with our team leader tomorrow.

qs.q: What event is the man ordering food for?
qs.x: 첫 대사 ‘다음 주 월요일 training session에 30명’이 근거입니다.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. How much per person will the man most likely pay?
qs.x: 조건 두 개: ‘따뜻한 음식(warm)’ + ‘1인 25달러 이하’. hot 메뉴 중 25달러 이하는 Hot Buffet $22 하나뿐입니다. Premium $28은 예산 초과.

qs.q: What does the woman ask the man to provide by Thursday?
qs.x: ‘exact number of people by Thursday’ → number of attendees로 바꿔 말한 정답입니다.

p3.script:
W Hi, Tom. The shipment of winter jackets was supposed to arrive this morning, but the delivery company just called. Their truck broke down outside the city.
M That's bad timing. Our winter sale starts on Saturday, and those jackets are in all our flyers.
W They said they can send them on a different truck, but it won't get here until Friday night.
M Friday night? Our stock team leaves at six.
W I know. I could ask a few people to stay late and put the jackets out before we open on Saturday.
M That would help. Make sure they get overtime pay for it. And let's put up a sign near the entrance saying more styles are arriving soon, just in case.

qs.q: What is the problem?
qs.x: 여자 ‘트럭이 고장 나서(broke down) 아침에 올 물건이 금요일 밤에 온다’ → 배송 지연이 문제입니다.

qs.q: What does the man imply when he says, "Our stock team leaves at six"?
o: No employees will be available to unload the items.
The store will close early on Friday.
He plans to hire more stock clerks.
He cannot attend a meeting that evening.
qs.x: 물건은 ‘금요일 밤’ 도착 → 재고팀은 6시 퇴근. 즉 받을 사람이 없다는 걱정입니다. 바로 뒤 여자 ‘몇 명 남겨서 일하게 하겠다’가 확인해 줍니다.

qs.q: What does the man suggest doing?
o: Posting a sign at the entrance
Changing the date of the sale
qs.x: 마지막 대사 ‘let's put up a sign near the entrance’가 그대로 정답입니다.

p3.script:
M Hi, Rachel. Did you get the e-mail from IT about the new expense reporting software?
W I did. It says we'll switch over on November first. I'm a little worried, though. I submit dozens of travel expenses every month.
M From what I've heard, it's actually much faster. You just take a photo of a receipt with your phone, and it fills in the amount automatically.
W That would save me a lot of time. Is there any training?
M Yes. IT is holding a one-hour online session next Wednesday at two. You have to register on the company intranet.
W Hmm, I have a client call at two on Wednesday.
M They're also recording it, so you can watch it later. I'll forward you the link as soon as it's available.

qs.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
qs.x: 첫 대사 ‘new expense reporting software’가 대화 주제입니다.

qs.q: What feature of the software does the man mention?
o: It works without an Internet connection.
It connects directly to bank accounts.
It reads information from receipt photos.
qs.x: ‘영수증을 폰으로 찍으면 금액이 자동 입력된다’ → 사진에서 정보를 읽는 기능입니다.

qs.q: What does the man offer to do?
o: Register the woman for a session
Send the woman a link to a recording
qs.x: 마지막 대사 ‘녹화본 링크를 forward 해 주겠다’가 근거. 등록은 본인이 인트라넷에서 하라고 했으니 함정입니다.

qs.q: According to the man, what can the woman receive at the café?

p3.script:
M Excuse me, my flight to Vancouver was just canceled. I have an important sales meeting there tomorrow at ten a.m.
W I'm sorry about that, sir. The storm has grounded all flights this evening. Let me see what I can do... The earliest flight I can put you on leaves at six fifteen tomorrow morning and lands at eight forty.
M That should still give me enough time. Will I need to pay anything extra?
W No, the change is free because the cancellation was due to the weather. We're also providing hotel vouchers for passengers who are stuck here overnight.
M That's helpful. Which hotel is it?
W The Airport Grand. A free shuttle leaves from Door Five every twenty minutes. Here's your voucher and your new boarding pass.

qs.q: Why is the man traveling to Vancouver?
o: To give a presentation at a conference
qs.x: 첫 대사 ‘내일 오전 10시 중요한 sales meeting’이 근거입니다.

qs.q: What caused the flight cancellation?
qs.x: ‘The storm has grounded all flights’ + ‘due to the weather’ → 악천후가 원인입니다.

qs.q: What does the woman give the man?
qs.x: 마지막 대사 ‘Here's your voucher(호텔 바우처) and your new boarding pass’가 근거입니다.

p3.script:
M Thanks for meeting with me. As the facilities manager, I wanted to update you both on the break room renovation. The contractor says they can start on the twelfth.
W1 That's sooner than we expected. How long will the work take?
M About two weeks. During that time, the room will be completely closed, including the refrigerators.
W2 Hmm, a lot of our staff bring their lunch from home. Where will they keep their food?
M Good point. I could rent a couple of portable refrigerators and put them in the conference room on the second floor.
W1 That works, as long as we don't have any client meetings scheduled there. Sophie, can you check the room calendar?
W2 Sure. I'll look at it this afternoon and let you both know.

qs.q: Who most likely is the man?
qs.x: 첫 대사 ‘As the facilities manager’에서 직업이 그대로 나옵니다. contractor는 대화 속 제3자라 함정.

qs.q: What concern does one of the women raise?
o: Employees will have nowhere to store food.
The renovation will cost too much.
The work will take longer than planned.
Clients may be bothered by the noise.
qs.x: Sophie ‘직원들이 도시락을 어디에 보관하냐(Where will they keep their food?)’가 근거입니다.

qs.q: What does Sophie agree to do this afternoon?

p4.script: W Welcome back to Work Smarter, the podcast that helps you get more done in less time. I'm your host, Jenna Wu. Today's topic is something we all deal with: e-mail. qs.q: What is the topic of today's episode?
qs.x: ‘Today's topic is … e-mail’ → 이메일 관리가 주제입니다.

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "Thirty times!"?
o: To emphasize that a number is surprisingly high
To correct a figure she gave earlier
To ask listeners to share their opinions
To suggest a daily goal for listeners

qs.q: What will listeners most likely hear next?
qs.x: 마지막 ‘But first, a quick word from our sponsor’ → 바로 다음은 광고. 코치 인터뷰는 ‘Later in the show’라 함정입니다.

qs.q: Where most likely is the announcement being made?
o: At a shopping mall food court

qs.q: What is discounted tonight?
qs.x: ‘오늘 밤만 bakery section 전 품목 40% 할인’이 근거입니다.

qs.q: What will change starting next Monday?
o: A mobile app will be launched.

p4.script: M Hello, this is Raymond Cho from the Delmont Community Center, calling for Ms. Jessica Lane. You signed up for our Saturday pottery workshop, and I'm calling with a quick update. Our instructor has a family matter to attend to, so the workshop will start at one p.m. instead of ten a.m. The location hasn't changed. It's still in Studio B on the second floor. If the new time doesn't work for you, just let me know, and I can move you to next month's session at no extra cost.

qs.q: Why is the speaker calling?
o: To announce a change of location
qs.x: ‘오전 10시가 아니라 오후 1시에 시작’ → 일정 변경 안내. 장소는 그대로라고 했으니 함정입니다.

qs.q: What does the speaker advise the listener to do?
o: Wear clothing that can get dirty
qs.x: ‘더러워져도 괜찮은 옷을 입고 오라’가 근거. 앞치마·도구는 제공된다고 했습니다.

qs.q: What does the speaker offer to do?
o: Provide free materials for a month
Transfer the listener to a later session
qs.x: 마지막 ‘시간이 안 맞으면 다음 달 세션으로 옮겨 드리겠다(at no extra cost)’ → 환불이 아니라 이동입니다.

p5.q: Ms. Okafor's presentation on regional sales trends was ------- organized and easy to follow.
p5.x: be동사(was)와 과거분사 organized 사이 → 분사를 꾸미는 부사 carefully. careful(형용사)·care/carefulness(명사)는 분사 앞 수식 자리에 올 수 없습니다.

p5.q: Employees who wish to attend the safety workshop should submit ------- registration forms to Mr. Dunmore by Friday.
p5.x: 명사 registration forms 앞 → 소유격 their. they(주격)·them(목적격)·themselves(재귀)는 명사를 꾸밀 수 없습니다.

p5.q: Customers must present a receipt as ------- of purchase when returning merchandise.
p5.x: proof of purchase = 구매 증빙(고정 표현). 영수증의 역할은 '증빙'입니다. reason(이유)·sample(견본)·notice(공지)는 의미가 맞지 않습니다.

p5.q: The Harlow Street branch of Pinecrest Bank ------- for renovations since early September.
p5.x: since + 과거 시점 → 현재완료. 지점은 '닫힌' 상태이므로 수동 has been closed. 현재·미래·진행형은 since와 함께 쓸 수 없습니다.

p5.q: All visitors are required to sign in at the front desk ------- entering the research laboratory.
p5.x: 뒤에 동명사 entering → '들어가기 전에' before. among(~ 사이에)·beside(~ 옆에)·within(~ 이내에)은 동작의 순서를 나타내지 못합니다.

p5.q: Members of the Kestrel Airlines loyalty program receive ------- seating on all international flights.
p5.x: 명사 seating 앞 → 형용사 역할의 과거분사 preferred(우대 좌석). prefer(동사)·preferably(부사)는 명사를 꾸밀 수 없고, preference seating이라는 복합명사는 쓰지 않습니다.

p5.q: The list of approved suppliers ------- reviewed by the purchasing department every quarter.
p5.x: 주어의 핵심은 단수 The list(of approved suppliers는 수식어) → is. are/were는 복수 동사, have reviewed는 복수·능동이라 '검토된다'는 뜻이 안 됩니다.

p5.q: Before signing the lease, Mr. Patel asked his lawyer to ------- the terms of the agreement carefully.
p5.x: review the terms = 조건을 검토하다. remain(남다)은 목적어를 못 받는 자동사, inform은 사람을 목적어로(inform A of B), attend(참석하다)는 회의·행사와 어울립니다.

p5.q: ------- the shipment arrived two days late, the store was able to stock its shelves before the holiday sale.
p5.x: 뒤에 절(주어+동사) + '늦게 왔지만 진열했다'는 양보 → Although. Despite는 전치사라 절을 받지 못하고, Because(이유)·Unless(조건)는 의미가 맞지 않습니다.

p5.q: The new accounting software is fully ------- with the operating systems currently used in our offices.
p5.x: be compatible with = ~와 호환되는. comparable(비교할 만한)·considerable(상당한)·competent(유능한)는 소프트웨어 호환 문맥과 맞지 않습니다.

p5.q: Ms. Lindqvist prefers to handle client complaints ------- rather than delegate them to her assistants.
p5.x: 이미 완전한 문장 뒤에서 '직접, 손수'를 강조 → 재귀대명사 herself. her·hers·she는 이 자리에서 문장 구조가 성립하지 않습니다.

p5.q: Because of the heavy snowfall, the delivery schedule has been ------- adjusted for the rest of the week.
p5.x: 폭설 때문에 '이번 주 남은 기간 동안만' 조정 → temporarily(일시적으로). nearly(거의)·formerly(이전에)는 문맥과 안 맞고, closely(면밀히)는 adjusted와 자연스럽게 결합하지 않습니다.

p5.q: Applicants ------- résumés are selected for the next round will be contacted by e-mail within ten days.
p5.x: 선행사 Applicants와 뒤 명사 résumés가 '지원자의 이력서'라는 소유 관계 → whose. who·which 뒤에는 주어 빠진 절, whom 뒤에는 목적어 빠진 절이 와야 하는데 여기는 완전한 절입니다.

p5.q: Due to high ------- for the limited-edition headphones, each customer may purchase only two units.
p5.x: high demand for = ~에 대한 높은 수요 → 1인 2개 구매 제한의 이유. request·inquiry는 high와 잘 결합하지 않고, supply(공급)가 많으면 구매를 제한할 이유가 없습니다.

p5.q: The marketing team plans ------- a series of online advertisements targeting first-time home buyers.
p5.x: plan은 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사 → plans to launch. launching(동명사)·launched·launch는 plans 바로 뒤에 올 수 없습니다.

p5.q: Ferrow Logistics will ------- its fleet of delivery vans to include twenty electric vehicles next year.
p5.x: expand its fleet = 보유 차량 규모를 늘리다. prolong(기간을 연장하다)·elevate(높이 올리다)·attain(달성하다)은 fleet와 어울리지 않습니다.

p5.q: Dr. Huang's research on coastal erosion ------- in the next issue of Marine Science Quarterly.
p5.x: 연구는 '게재되는' 대상 + next issue(미래) → 미래 수동 will be published. 능동형(will publish·has published·publishes)은 뒤에 목적어가 필요해 맞지 않습니다.

p5.q: Of all the proposals submitted this year, Ms. Arceneaux's was by far the ------- to implement.
p5.x: Of all ~ + by far(최상급 강조) + the → 최상급 easiest. easier는 than과 함께 쓰고, easily는 부사라 보어 자리에 올 수 없습니다.

p5.q: Interns at Corvell Design receive ------- feedback from senior designers throughout their placement.
p5.x: constructive feedback = 건설적인 피드백(고정 결합). fortunate(운 좋은)·eventual(최종적인)·dependent(의존하는)는 feedback과 어울리지 않습니다.

p5.q: ------- the merger with Alton Foods, Brisa Beverages will operate as an independent subsidiary.
p5.x: 뒤에 명사구 the merger만 있음 → 전치사 Following(~ 후에). Even though·Whereas·As soon as는 접속사라 뒤에 절(주어+동사)이 와야 합니다.

p5.q: Full ------- for travel expenses will be provided once employees submit their original receipts.
p5.x: reimbursement for expenses = 경비 환급. 영수증 제출 후 지급되는 것은 환급입니다. admission(입장)·enrollment(등록)·dedication(헌신)은 의미가 맞지 않습니다.

p5.q: The brochures ------- at the trade fair last week generated more than 300 customer inquiries.
p5.x: 문장의 동사는 generated → 빈칸은 brochures를 뒤에서 꾸미는 분사. 브로슈어는 '배포된' 것이므로 과거분사 distributed. were distributed는 동사가 두 개가 되고, distributing은 능동이라 의미가 반대입니다.

p5.q: The renovation of the east wing is ------- complete, with only the lighting fixtures left to install.
p5.x: 조명만 남았다 → '거의' 완료 nearly. recently(최근에)·previously(이전에)·shortly(곧)는 complete의 정도를 나타내지 못합니다.

p5.q: Ms. Fontaine will approve the budget proposal ------- the department can show that the new equipment will reduce costs.
p5.x: '비용 절감을 입증한다면' 승인 → 조건 접속사 provided that(~라면). so that(목적)·whether(~인지)는 의미가 안 맞고, in case of는 전치사라 절을 받지 못합니다.

p5.q: The city council voted to ------- the outdated zoning regulation that had prevented new cafés from opening downtown.
p5.x: repeal a regulation = 규정을 폐지하다. resign(사임하다)·retire(은퇴하다)·refrain(삼가다, refrain from)은 규정을 목적어로 받지 않습니다.

p5.q: The survey results show that ------- customers value most is fast and reliable delivery.
p5.x: that절 안에서 '고객이 가장 중시하는 것'이 주어, value의 목적어도 비어 있음 → 선행사를 품은 관계대명사 what. which·that·whose는 앞에 선행사가 있어야 합니다.

p5.q: Given the ------- nature of the client data, access to the files is restricted to authorized staff only.
p5.x: sensitive data = 민감한 정보 → 접근 제한의 이유. sensible(분별 있는)·sensory(감각의)·sensational(선풍적인)은 모양만 비슷한 오답입니다.

p5.q: The board's decision to postpone the expansion was made at the ------- of the chief financial officer.
p5.x: at the insistence of = ~의 강력한 요구로(고정 표현) → 결정의 근거. persistence(끈기)·assistance(도움)·resistance(저항)는 at the ~ of 형태로 이 의미를 만들지 못합니다.

p5.q: The safety inspector recommended that the factory ------- its ventilation system before the end of the year.
p5.x: recommend that + 주어 + (should) 동사원형 → upgrade. 주어가 3인칭 단수여도 upgrades를 쓰지 않으며, 과거형·미래형도 불가합니다.

p5.q: Although the two proposals differ in scope, their projected budgets are ------- identical.
p5.x: virtually identical = 사실상 똑같은(고정 결합). approximately는 수치 앞에 쓰고(approximately $5,000), exclusively(독점적으로)·respectively(각각)는 identical을 꾸미지 못합니다.
